info.name: Upravnik Platform
info.description:
Full API collection for the Upravnik platform.

**Quick start:**
1. Send any Login request — token saves automatically to {{authToken}}
2. All other requests use it via Bearer auth

**Seeded accounts:**
- SUPER_ADMIN  → admin@upravnik.rs / Admin123!
- UPRAVNIK     → upravnik@zgrada.rs / Upravnik123!
- BOARD_MEMBER → board@zgrada.rs / Board123!
- RESIDENT     → 1A / 2A / 2B / 3A ... / Resident123!

**Access rules (all endpoints):**
- Every endpoint requires a Bearer token except the Login requests.
- `401` — no token, bad/expired token, the account is disabled, or the token was issued before the user's last password reset. Send the user back to login.
- Building routes (`/buildings/:buildingId/...`) require an *active* membership in that building; complex routes (`/complexes/:complexId/...`) require an active membership in any building of the complex. Non-members get `403` — this check runs before any lookup, so a non-member gets `403` even for a building that doesn't exist. SUPER_ADMIN passes every membership check.
- `404` — an unknown or malformed id (previously some of these were `500`).
- `409` — unique conflict (e.g. email or unit number already in use), or a reply to a CLOSED thread/ticket.
- `400` — invalid body or query params, including unknown query params.

request.description:
Authenticates a user and returns a JWT access token. The token is valid for 7 days. Use any of the Login requests to switch between roles — the token is saved automatically to {{authToken}}.

**Who can call it:** Anyone (no auth required).

**Body fields:**
- `username` (string, required) — email for system users (SUPER_ADMIN, UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER); unit number (e.g. '1A') for residents
- `password` (string, required)

**Errors:**
- `401` — invalid credentials or account is disabled
- `429` — too many attempts: max 5 login requests per minute per IP + username. Show "Too many attempts, try again in a minute".

Authenticates as SUPER_ADMIN. Token is saved to {{authToken}}.

**Response:** `{ accessToken: string }`

**Errors:**
- `401` — invalid credentials or account is disabled
- `429` — too many attempts: max 5 login requests per minute per IP + username. Show "Too many attempts, try again in a minute".

Authenticates as BOARD_MEMBER of Lamela 1. Token is saved to {{authToken}}.

Board members are building-specific: board.l1@zgrada.rs (Lamela 1), board.l2@zgrada.rs (Lamela 2), board.l3@zgrada.rs (Lamela 3), board.l4@zgrada.rs (Lamela 4).

**Response:** `{ accessToken: string }`

**Errors:**
- `401` — invalid credentials or account is disabled
- `429` — too many attempts: max 5 login requests per minute per IP + username. Show "Too many attempts, try again in a minute".

Authenticates as RESIDENT (unit 1A). Token is saved to {{authToken}}.

**Response:** `{ accessToken: string }`

**Errors:**

- `429` — too many attempts: max 5 login requests per minute per IP + username. Show "Too many attempts, try again in a minute".

**Response:** `{ accessToken: string }`

**Errors:**

Returns the full profile of the currently authenticated user including building memberships, unit info (for residents), and all threads they have created.

**Who can call it:** Any authenticated user.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Response fields:**
- `id` — user UUID
- `username` — email for system users, unit number for residents
- `email`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `phone` — profile info (nullable)
- `accountType` — `SYSTEM_USER` or `UNIT_ACCOUNT`
- `systemRole` — `SUPER_ADMIN` for the platform admin, `null` for everyone else
- `createdAt` — account creation timestamp
- `buildingMembers` — array of buildings this user belongs to, each with `role`, `joinedAt`, `building { id, name, address, city }`, `unit { id, unitNumber, floor, type }` (null for non-residents)
- `threads` — all threads created by this user, newest first, each with `id`, `title`, `category`, `status`, `createdAt`, `_count.replies`

**Errors:**
- `401` — no token or token expired

Logs out the current user. Since auth is stateless JWT, the token is not invalidated server-side — the client must discard it. The Postman test script clears {{authToken}} automatically on success.

**Who can call it:** Any authenticated user.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Response:** `{ message: 'Logged out' }`

**Errors:**
- `401` — no token or token expired

Creates a full property structure in a single atomic transaction: an optional complex, one or more buildings, and all units within each building. If any part fails, nothing is created.

**Who can call it:** SUPER_ADMIN only.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `complex` (object, optional) — omit entirely for standalone buildings
  - `name` (string, required)
  - `address` (string, required)
  - `city` (string, required)
- `buildings` (array, required, min 1)
  - `name` (string, required)
  - `address` (string, required)
  - `city` (string, required)
  - `units` (array, required, min 1, max 1000)
    - `unitNumber` (string, required) — unique within the building
    - `floor` (integer, optional)
    - `type` (string, required) — `APARTMENT` | `OFFICE` | `COMMERCIAL`
    - `areaSqm` (decimal, optional)

**Errors:**
- `400` — validation error. Also returned when a building repeats a `unitNumber`: `message` is then an array with one Serbian string per affected building, e.g. `["Zgrada A: duplirani brojevi jedinica 1-2"]`. Nothing is created.
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not SUPER_ADMIN

request.description:
Creates a new system user (UPRAVNIK). These are named accounts with email/password login that manage buildings. Only SUPER_ADMIN can call this.

**Who can call it:** SUPER_ADMIN only.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `email` (string, required) — used as the username for login
- `password` (string, required) — plaintext, hashed on the server
- `firstName` (string, optional)
- `lastName` (string, optional)
- `phone` (string, optional)
- `buildingIds` (string[], optional) — UUIDs of buildings to assign this upravnik to immediately. A `BuildingMember` record with role `UPRAVNIK` is created for each.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not SUPER_ADMIN
- `409` — email already in use

request.description:
Creates a board member (BOARD_MEMBER) account for a specific building. Board members are appointed by the upravnik to manage announcements — they are not tenants and have no unit. The account uses email/password login (SYSTEM_USER account type).

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK only (must be an UPRAVNIK of the specified building).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required) — the building this board member will manage

**Body fields:**
- `email` (string, required) — used as the login username
- `password` (string, required) — set by the upravnik, given to the board member
- `firstName` (string, optional)
- `lastName` (string, optional)
- `phone` (string, optional)

**Side effects:** Creates a `BuildingMember` record with role `BOARD_MEMBER`. No unit is linked.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not UPRAVNIK in this building
- `409` — email already in use

request.description:
Creates a unit account (RESIDENT) for a specific unit in a building. The username is the unit number (e.g. '2A') and the password is auto-generated. The plaintext password is returned only once in this response — store it and give it to the resident.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK only (must be an UPRAVNIK of the specified building).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Body fields:**
- `unitId` (UUID, required) — the unit to associate the account with
- `unitNumber` (string, required) — becomes the login username
- `firstName` (string, optional)
- `lastName` (string, optional)
- `email` (string, optional)
- `phone` (string, optional)

**Side effects:** Creates a `BuildingMember` record with role `RESIDENT` and links the user to the unit.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not UPRAVNIK in this building
- `404` — `unitId` does not exist or does not belong to `buildingId`
- `409` — unit number already has an account

Generates a new random 12-character password (letters A–Z and digits 2–9, no look-alike characters) for a resident unit account and returns it in plaintext. The new password is returned only once — give it to the user immediately.

Only **active RESIDENT unit accounts of this building** can be reset. Board members, other UPRAVNIKs, deactivated members and users of other buildings get `404`.

**Side effects:** every token issued to that user before the reset stops working (`401`), so they are logged out everywhere.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK only (must be an UPRAVNIK of the specified building).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required) — the building the user belongs to (used to verify UPRAVNIK access)
- `userId` (UUID, required) — the unit account to reset

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not UPRAVNIK in this building
- `404` — user is not an active resident unit account of this building

Enables or disables a whole account. A disabled account can't log in, all its existing tokens get `401` immediately, and its chat sockets are disconnected. Its history (posts, replies, tickets) is kept. Setting `isActive: true` re-enables it.

**Who can call it:** SUPER_ADMIN only.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `userId` (UUID, required) — the account to change

**Body fields:**
- `isActive` (boolean, required) — `false` disables, `true` enables

**Response:** the updated user: `id`, `username`, `email`, `accountType`, `isActive`, `updatedAt`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — `isActive` missing or not a boolean, or trying to disable your own account
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not SUPER_ADMIN
- `404` — user not found

Creates a new residential complex. A complex is a top-level grouping that can contain multiple buildings.

**Who can call it:** SUPER_ADMIN only.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `name` (string, required) — name of the complex
- `address` (string, required) — street address
- `city` (string, required)

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not SUPER_ADMIN

Returns complexes with their associated buildings, scoped to the caller: SUPER_ADMIN receives every complex in the system; all other roles only receive complexes that contain at least one building they are a member of.

**Who can call it:** Any authenticated user.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Response:** Array of complex objects, each including a `buildings` array.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated

Returns a single complex by ID including its buildings.

**Who can call it:** SUPER_ADMIN, or any authenticated user who is a member of at least one building within this complex.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `id` (UUID, required) — the complex ID

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user has no membership in any building of this complex
- `404` — complex not found

Creates a new building, optionally linked to a complex.

**Who can call it:** SUPER_ADMIN only.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `name` (string, required)
- `address` (string, required)
- `city` (string, required)
- `complexId` (UUID, optional) — link to an existing complex

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not SUPER_ADMIN

Returns buildings with their parent complex, scoped to the caller: SUPER_ADMIN receives every building in the system; all other roles (UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, RESIDENT) only receive buildings they are a member of.

**Who can call it:** Any authenticated user.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Response:** Array of building objects, each including a `complex` object (nullable if not linked to a complex).

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated

Returns a single building by ID with full detail: complex, all units, and all members (with user data). The nested `members[].user` object never includes the password hash.

**Who can call it:** Any authenticated member of this building (UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, RESIDENT, or SUPER_ADMIN).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `id` (UUID, required) — the building ID

**Response includes:**
- `complex` — parent complex (nullable)
- `units` — all units in the building
- `members` — all building members with their full user object and role

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not a member of this building
- `404` — building not found

Activates or deactivates one user's membership in this building. A deactivated member loses access to the building immediately (`403` on its routes, removed from its chat room, no longer included in `GET /buildings`, `/threads`, `/tickets`, `/announcements` lists). The account itself stays active and their history is kept. Setting `isActive: true` restores access.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN). Only SUPER_ADMIN may change another UPRAVNIK's membership.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `userId` (UUID, required) — the member to change

**Body fields:**
- `isActive` (boolean, required)

**Response:** the membership: `id`, `buildingId`, `userId`, `role`, `unitId` (null for staff), `isActive`, `joinedAt`.

**Side effects:** on deactivation, the user's open chat sockets leave this building's room.

**Errors:**
- `400` — `isActive` missing or not a boolean
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not UPRAVNIK of this building, or the target is an UPRAVNIK and the caller is not SUPER_ADMIN
- `404` — the user is not a member of this building

Creates a new unit (apartment, office, or commercial space) inside a building. Once created, use Create Unit Account to assign a resident login to this unit.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK only.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Body fields:**
- `unitNumber` (string, required, unique within the building) — e.g. '1A', '3B'
- `floor` (integer, optional)
- `type` (string, required) — `APARTMENT`, `OFFICE`, or `COMMERCIAL`
- `areaSqm` (decimal, optional) — area in square meters

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not UPRAVNIK
- `409` — a unit with this `unitNumber` already exists in the building

Returns all units in a building, each including the associated user account (if one has been created for that unit).

**Who can call it:** Any authenticated member of this building (UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, RESIDENT, or SUPER_ADMIN).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Response:** Array of unit objects, each with a `user` field (nullable).

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not a member of this building

Returns a single unit by ID including the associated user account.

**Who can call it:** Any authenticated member of this building (UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, RESIDENT, or SUPER_ADMIN).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `id` (UUID, required) — the unit ID

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not a member of this building
- `404` — unit not found, or the unit does not belong to this building

request.description:
Returns all announcements across every building the authenticated user belongs to (or across ALL buildings for SUPER_ADMIN). Pinned announcements appear first per the standard ordering rule, then by `createdAt` descending. Each result includes `building { id, name }` so the frontend can group or label by building.

**Who can call it:** Any authenticated user (SUPER_ADMIN, UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, RESIDENT). SUPER_ADMIN sees announcements from every building in the system (no membership required). Everyone else is scoped to their own building memberships; if `buildingId` is passed and the caller is not a member of that building, an empty array is returned (not an error).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Query params (all optional):**
- `buildingId` (UUID) — narrow results to one building (any building for SUPER_ADMIN; one you are a member of otherwise)

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated

**Validation:** `buildingId` must be a UUID and `status` (where supported) must be `OPEN` or `CLOSED`; unknown query params are rejected. Invalid params return `400`. For everyone except SUPER_ADMIN, only buildings where the caller has an *active* membership are included.

request.description:
Uploads a document record for a building. The file itself must be hosted externally — this endpoint only stores the metadata and URL.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Body fields:**
- `title` (string, required)
- `fileUrl` (string, required) — publicly accessible **https** URL to the file (`http:`, `javascript:` etc. are rejected)
- `fileType` (string, optional) — e.g. 'pdf', 'docx'
- `category` (string, required) — `CONTRACT`, `REPORT`, `DECISION`, or `OTHER`

**Errors:**
- `400` — missing/invalid fields, or `fileUrl` is not an https URL
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not UPRAVNIK or BOARD_MEMBER

Returns all documents for a building ordered by `createdAt` descending. Each document includes the uploader's name.

**Who can call it:** Any authenticated member of this building (UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, RESIDENT, or SUPER_ADMIN).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**`fileUrl` / `fileId`:** uploaded documents have an https `fileUrl` and `fileId: null`. Documents generated by the app (published financial reports) have `fileUrl: null` and a `fileId`; open those through Get File Download URL (`/buildings/:buildingId/files/:fileId/download`).

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not a member of this building

Returns a single document by ID. Note: uploader info is not included in this response — use Get All Documents if you need the uploader name.

**Who can call it:** Any authenticated member of this building (UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, RESIDENT, or SUPER_ADMIN).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `id` (UUID, required) — the document ID

**`fileUrl` / `fileId`:** uploaded documents have an https `fileUrl` and `fileId: null`. Documents generated by the app (published financial reports) have `fileUrl: null` and a `fileId`; open those through Get File Download URL (`/buildings/:buildingId/files/:fileId/download`).

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — authenticated user is not a member of this building
- `404` — document not found, or the document does not belong to this building

The building HOA's (stambena zajednica) public profile and bank accounts with their current balances. This is the header of the "Finansije" tab: legal name, PIB, matični broj, address, and every bank account (bank + account number to pay into) with its balance, plus the total.

**Who can call it:** Any active member of this building (UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, RESIDENT) or SUPER_ADMIN.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Response when not set up:** `{ "configured": false }` — show an empty state ("Finansije zgrade još nisu podešene"); for the UPRAVNIK show a setup button that calls `PUT /finance/profile`.

**Response when set up:**
- `configured: true`
- `entity` — `{ id, buildingId, complexId, legalName, pib, maticniBroj, address, booksStartDate, createdAt, updatedAt }`
- `bankAccounts[]` — `{ id, entityId, bankName, accountNumber (18 digits, format as 3-13-2 for display), isPrimary, isActive, openingBalance, balance, createdAt, updatedAt }`, primary first. `balance` = openingBalance + all income − all expense.
- `totalBalance` — sum of all account balances.
- `unassignedPayments` (integer) — owner payments booked without a unit that are not reversed. They count as building income but reduce no unit's debt; show "Nerazvrstane uplate ({n})" to staff when > 0.

**Money:** all amounts are RSD decimal strings, never numbers. Stored amounts (`amount`, `openingBalance`) are serialised without trailing zeros (e.g. `"3000"`, `"3000.5"`); computed totals (`balance`, `paidAmount`, summary values) always have 2 decimals (`"3000.00"`). Format on the client.

**`bankAccounts[].importMapping`:** the CSV mapping saved by the last statement upload on that account (see Upload Statement), or `null`. Use it to prefill the upload form.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — not an active member of this building

request.description:
Creates the building's HOA finance profile, or updates it. The first call also creates the default income/expense categories (Uplate vlasnika, Struja, Čišćenje, Održavanje lifta, …), which the upravnik can then rename, deactivate or extend.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Body fields:**
- `legalName` (string, required)
- `pib` (string, required) — 9-digit PIB with a valid check digit
- `maticniBroj` (string, required) — 8 digits
- `address` (string, optional)
- `booksStartDate` (string `YYYY-MM-DD`, required) — the date the books start; bank account opening balances are as of this date and no transaction may be dated before it. Can only change while there are no transactions.
- `paymentTermDays` (integer 0–365, optional, default 30) — days after a unit charge is issued before it counts as overdue; also drives overdue reminders
- `autoGenerateCharges` (boolean, optional, default false) — issue the monthly unit charges automatically on the 1st at 06:00 (Europe/Belgrade)

**Response:** the FinanceEntity `{ id, buildingId, complexId, legalName, pib, maticniBroj, address, booksStartDate, paymentTermDays, autoGenerateCharges, createdAt, updatedAt }`. Status `200`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — missing/invalid fields (invalid PIB check digit, matični broj not 8 digits, bad date)
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — building not found

Adds a fee rule used by monthly charge generation. At most one rule may apply per fund + unit type in any month.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Body fields:**
- `fund` (enum `TEKUCE_ODRZAVANJE | INVESTICIONO_ODRZAVANJE | UPRAVLJANJE | HITNE_INTERVENCIJE | OSTALO`, required)
- `method` (enum `PER_UNIT | PER_SQM`, required) — flat amount per unit, or amount × `Unit.areaSqm`
- `amount` (string, required) — ≥ 0, up to 2 decimals; `0` exempts the unit type from the fund
- `unitType` (enum `APARTMENT | OFFICE | COMMERCIAL` or `null`, optional) — `null`/omitted = default for every type; a rule for a specific type overrides the default
- `validFrom` (string `YYYY-MM`, required) — first month the rule applies
- `validTo` (string `YYYY-MM` or `null`, optional) — last month (inclusive); `null` = open-ended
- `decisionDocumentId` (UUID or `null`, optional) — the assembly decision, a Document of this building

**Response:** the created rule (without `decisionDocument`). Status `201`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — invalid fields (bad period format, negative amount, unknown enum)
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — finances not set up, or the decision document is not in this building
- `409` — another rule for the same fund and unit type overlaps this period
- `422` — `validTo` before `validFrom`

**Side effects:** writes an `AuditLog` row with a snapshot of the record.

Changes a fee rule. Already issued charges are not touched; use Regenerate Charges to apply the new amount to a month.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `id` (UUID, required) — the fee rule

**Body fields (all optional):**
- `fund` (enum `TEKUCE_ODRZAVANJE | INVESTICIONO_ODRZAVANJE | UPRAVLJANJE | HITNE_INTERVENCIJE | OSTALO`)
- `method` (enum `PER_UNIT | PER_SQM`) — flat amount per unit, or amount × `Unit.areaSqm`
- `amount` (string) — ≥ 0, up to 2 decimals; `0` exempts the unit type from the fund
- `unitType` (enum `APARTMENT | OFFICE | COMMERCIAL` or `null`, optional) — `null`/omitted = default for every type; a rule for a specific type overrides the default
- `validFrom` (string `YYYY-MM`) — first month the rule applies
- `validTo` (string `YYYY-MM` or `null`, optional) — last month (inclusive); `null` = open-ended
- `decisionDocumentId` (UUID or `null`, optional) — the assembly decision, a Document of this building

**Response:** the updated rule. Status `200`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — invalid fields
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — rule or decision document not found in this building
- `409` — the change makes it overlap another rule for the same fund and unit type
- `422` — `validTo` before `validFrom`

**Side effects:** writes an `AuditLog` row with a snapshot of the record.

Shows what monthly generation would charge each unit for a month, compared with what is already issued. Read-only.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK or BOARD_MEMBER of this building, SUPER_ADMIN. RESIDENT gets `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Params:**
- `buildingId` (path, UUID, required)
- `period` (string `YYYY-MM`, required) (query) — any month; generation is allowed from the month `booksStartDate` falls in up to the current month

**Response:** `{ period, issueDate (1st of the month), units: [{ unitId, unitNumber, type, areaSqm, lines: [{ fund, method, rate, amount, issuedAmount, status }], total, missingArea }], total, missingArea: string[] (unit numbers), canGenerate }`. Units are sorted by floor and number.

Line `status`:
- `NEW` — not issued yet
- `ISSUED` — issued with the same amount
- `CHANGED` — issued with a different amount (`issuedAmount` is the old one), or the rule no longer applies (`amount` `"0.00"`)
- `CANCELLED` — issued and then cancelled by hand; only Regenerate reissues it

`amount` is `null` when a `PER_SQM` rule meets a unit without `areaSqm`; such units are listed in `missingArea` and block generation. `method`/`rate` are `null` for a line whose rule is gone. `canGenerate` is `false` when the month is before the books start or in the future. Status `200`.

**Period lock:** `isLocked: true` when the month's 1st falls inside a period locked by a published financial report; `canGenerate` is then `false` and Generate / Regenerate return `409`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — `period` missing or not `YYYY-MM`
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — RESIDENT or not a member
- `404` — finances not set up

Issues the month's charges that were never issued (lines with status `NEW` in the preview), dated the 1st of the month. Safe to repeat: a second call issues nothing. Charges cancelled by hand are not reissued.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Body fields:**
- `period` (string `YYYY-MM`, required) — from the month `booksStartDate` falls in up to the current month

**Response:** `{ period, issuedCount, cancelledCount (always 0 here), unitCount (units that got a charge), total (sum issued) }`. Status `201`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — `period` missing or not `YYYY-MM`
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — finances not set up
- `422` — month before the books start or in the future, or a `PER_SQM` rule applies to units without area ("Nedostaje površina za stanove: …")
- `409` — the month is locked by a published financial report (preview shows `isLocked: true`)

**Side effects:** an `AuditLog` row per charge; assigns a poziv na broj to units that have none; each unit account that got a charge receives a notification "Novo zaduženje za {mesec}" with the amount and poziv na broj (link `/finances`). The same generation also runs automatically at 06:00 on the 1st for HOAs with `autoGenerateCharges`.

Brings a month in line with the current fee rules: every line that is not `ISSUED` in the preview (`NEW`, `CHANGED`, `CANCELLED`) is cancelled (reason "Ponovni obračun") and issued again with the current amount. Lines whose rule no longer applies are only cancelled. Unchanged charges are left alone.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Body fields:**
- `period` (string `YYYY-MM`, required) — from the month `booksStartDate` falls in up to the current month

**Response:** `{ period, issuedCount, cancelledCount, unitCount, total }`. Status `201`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — `period` missing or not `YYYY-MM`
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — finances not set up
- `422` — same as Generate Charges
- `409` — the month is locked by a published financial report

**Side effects:** `AuditLog` rows for cancelled and issued charges; affected unit accounts get "Izmenjeno zaduženje za {mesec}".

Cancels (stornira) one unit charge of any type. The charge stays in the ledger, crossed out, and no longer counts toward the balance. Generate will not reissue a cancelled monthly charge; Regenerate will.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `id` (UUID, required) — the charge

**Body fields:**
- `reason` (string, required)

**Response:** the charge `{ id, entityId, unitId, type, period, issueDate, fund, amount, description, createdBy, createdAt, cancelledAt, cancelReason }`. Status `201`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — missing reason
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — charge not found in this building
- `409` — already cancelled, or the charge's issue date is inside a period locked by a published financial report

**Side effects:** writes an `AuditLog` row with a snapshot of the record.

Records the debt (or prepayment) a unit carried over from before the books start, as a charge of type `OPENING` dated `booksStartDate`. One per unit; cancel it to enter a new one.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `unitId` (UUID, required)

**Body fields:**
- `amount` (string, required) — non-zero, up to 2 decimals; negative means the owner had paid ahead

**Response:** the created charge (`type: "OPENING"`, `description: "Početno stanje"`, `fund: null`). Status `201`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — invalid or zero amount
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — finances not set up, or unit not in this building
- `409` — the unit already has an active opening balance, or `booksStartDate` is inside a period locked by a published financial report

**Side effects:** writes an `AuditLog` row with a snapshot of the record.

Adds a one-off charge (positive amount) or credit (negative amount) to a unit, type `ADJUSTMENT`, dated today.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `unitId` (UUID, required)

**Body fields:**
- `amount` (string, required) — non-zero, up to 2 decimals
- `description` (string, required)
- `fund` (FinanceFund enum, optional)

**Response:** the created charge (`type: "ADJUSTMENT"`). Status `201`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — invalid/zero amount or missing description
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — finances not set up, or unit not in this building
- `422` — the books have not started yet
- `409` — the date falls inside a period locked by a published financial report ("Period je zaključen objavljenim izveštajem (…)")

**Side effects:** writes an `AuditLog` row with a snapshot of the record.

A unit's financial card: current balance, overdue amount, payment instructions and every charge and owner payment with the running balance.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER and SUPER_ADMIN for any unit; a RESIDENT only for their own unit (the unit account or the unit's member) — any other unit returns `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `unitId` (UUID, required)

**Response:**
- `unit` — `{ id, unitNumber, type, areaSqm }`
- `payTo` — `{ recipient (HOA legal name), accountNumber (primary active account, 18 digits, or null), model: "97", reference (poziv na broj, e.g. "95-0001") }`
- `paymentTermDays` — days after issue before a charge is overdue
- `balance` — positive = debt, negative = prepaid
- `overdueAmount`, `overdueSince` (date or null) — payments settle the oldest charges first (FIFO); whatever remains of charges older than the payment term is overdue
- `entries` — newest first. `kind: "CHARGE"`: `{ id, date, createdAt, type (MONTHLY | OPENING | ADJUSTMENT), fund, period, description, amount, cancelledAt, cancelReason, balanceAfter }`; `kind: "PAYMENT"`: `{ id, date, createdAt, isReversal, amount, balanceAfter }`, where `amount` is the effect on the debt (negative for a payment, positive for its storno). Cancelled charges do not change `balanceAfter`.

Status `200`.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — not a member, or a resident asking for another unit
- `404` — finances not set up, or unit not in this building

**Side effects:** assigns a poziv na broj to the building's units on first use.

Owner charges vs. payments for the whole building. Staff also get every unit's balance; residents only the totals.

**Who can call it:** any active member of this building (UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, RESIDENT) and SUPER_ADMIN.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Response (everyone):** `{ totalCharged, totalPaid, totalOutstanding (sum of positive balances), totalOverdue, unitsInArrears (units with an overdue amount), unitCount, collectionRate (percent paid of charged, 1 decimal, max 100, or null when nothing was charged) }`.

**Staff only (UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, SUPER_ADMIN):** also `units: [{ unitId, unitNumber, type, balance, overdueAmount, overdueSince }]`, sorted by floor and number. The key is absent for residents. Status `200`.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — not a member of this building
- `404` — finances not set up

Lists the building's bank statement (izvod) imports, newest first, for the Uvoz tab.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK or BOARD_MEMBER of this building, or SUPER_ADMIN. RESIDENT gets `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Response:** array of statements without lines: the fields of Get Statement Import except `summary`, `warnings` and `lines`, plus `_count { lines }`.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — RESIDENT or not a member
- `404` — finances not set up

One statement import with its lines, summary, balance warnings and per-line issues — the review screen.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK or BOARD_MEMBER of this building, or SUPER_ADMIN. RESIDENT gets `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `id` (UUID, required) — the import

**Response (statement):**
- `id`, `bankAccountId`, `fileId` (the uploaded CSV, a StoredFile), `statementNumber`, `openingBalance`, `closingBalance` (as entered, or null), `status` (`DRAFT` | `COMMITTED` | `DISCARDED`), `createdBy`, `createdAt`, `committedAt`
- `bankAccount { id, bankName, accountNumber }`, `file { id, fileName, sizeBytes }`, `creator { id, username, firstName, lastName }`
- `summary { lineCount, toBookCount (neither duplicate nor skipped), duplicateCount, skippedCount, income, expense }` — income/expense cover the lines to book only
- `warnings[]` (drafts only) — the statement's opening balance differs from the books before its first date; opening balance + lines ≠ closing balance. Warnings never block a commit.
- `lines[]` ordered by `lineNo` (the row number in the file, header counted): `{ id, lineNo, externalId, direction, amount, valueDate, counterpartyName, counterpartyAccount, reference, purpose, categoryId, unitId, invoiceId, skip, isDuplicate, transactionId, category { id, name, direction, fund, isOwnerPayment } | null, unit { id, unitNumber } | null, invoice { id, number, supplier { id, name } } | null, issues[] }`
  - `isDuplicate` — the same bank line (by `externalId`) is already booked on this account; it is never booked again and cannot be edited
  - `transactionId` — the booked transaction (after commit, or the earlier one for a duplicate)
  - `issues[]` — why the line cannot be booked as it stands (drafts only, empty for skipped/duplicate lines): "nedostaje kategorija", "datum je pre početka knjiženja", "datum je u budućnosti", "period je zaključen objavljenim izveštajem"

**Money:** stored amounts (`amount`, balances) are serialised without trailing zeros; summary totals have 2 decimals.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — RESIDENT or not a member
- `404` — finances not set up, or the import is not in this building

request.description:
Uploads a bank statement CSV and creates a **draft** import with proposed matches. Nothing is booked until Commit Statement Import. The NBS XML format is not supported yet.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Body:** `multipart/form-data` (fields above).

**`mapping` (CsvMapping):**
- `encoding` (`"utf-8"` | `"windows-1250"`, required)
- `delimiter` (one character, required; e.g. `";"`, `","`, `"\t"`)
- `skipRows` (int 0–50, required) — rows before the first data row; the header counts
- `dateFormat` (`"DD.MM.YYYY"` | `"YYYY-MM-DD"` | `"DD/MM/YYYY"`, required)
- `decimalSeparator` (`","` | `"."`, required) — the other one is the thousands separator
- `columns` (required, 0-based column indexes 0–99): `date` (required); **either** `amount` (signed, negative = expense) **or** both `debit` (isplata) and `credit` (uplata); optional `counterpartyName`, `counterpartyAccount`, `reference` (poziv na broj), `purpose` (svrha), `id` (the bank's own line id)

**Parsing:** quoted fields (RFC 4180) are supported; a UTF-8 BOM is ignored; empty rows are skipped; rows with a zero amount are skipped. Each line gets an `externalId` (the bank id column, else a hash of the row) used to detect lines already booked on this account.

**Proposed matches:** income whose poziv na broj equals a unit's `paymentReference` (with or without the `97` prefix) → that unit + the owner-payment category of tekuće održavanje; expense whose counterparty account equals a supplier's `bankAccount` → that supplier's open invoice whose number appears in the purpose (or its only open invoice) + the invoice's category. Lines already booked on this account are marked `isDuplicate`.

**Response:** the new draft, same shape as Get Statement Import. Status `201`.

**Response (statement):**
- `id`, `bankAccountId`, `fileId` (the uploaded CSV, a StoredFile), `statementNumber`, `openingBalance`, `closingBalance` (as entered, or null), `status` (`DRAFT` | `COMMITTED` | `DISCARDED`), `createdBy`, `createdAt`, `committedAt`
- `bankAccount { id, bankName, accountNumber }`, `file { id, fileName, sizeBytes }`, `creator { id, username, firstName, lastName }`
- `summary { lineCount, toBookCount (neither duplicate nor skipped), duplicateCount, skippedCount, income, expense }` — income/expense cover the lines to book only
- `warnings[]` (drafts only) — the statement's opening balance differs from the books before its first date; opening balance + lines ≠ closing balance. Warnings never block a commit.
- `lines[]` ordered by `lineNo` (the row number in the file, header counted): `{ id, lineNo, externalId, direction, amount, valueDate, counterpartyName, counterpartyAccount, reference, purpose, categoryId, unitId, invoiceId, skip, isDuplicate, transactionId, category { id, name, direction, fund, isOwnerPayment } | null, unit { id, unitNumber } | null, invoice { id, number, supplier { id, name } } | null, issues[] }`
  - `isDuplicate` — the same bank line (by `externalId`) is already booked on this account; it is never booked again and cannot be edited
  - `transactionId` — the booked transaction (after commit, or the earlier one for a duplicate)
  - `issues[]` — why the line cannot be booked as it stands (drafts only, empty for skipped/duplicate lines): "nedostaje kategorija", "datum je pre početka knjiženja", "datum je u budućnosti", "period je zaključen objavljenim izveštajem"

**Errors:**
- `400` — no file, or invalid fields (bad UUID, `mapping` not JSON, bad balance)
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — finances not set up, or the account is not in this building
- `413` — file larger than 10 MB
- `422` — inactive account; no mapping sent and none saved ("Za ovaj račun nije sačuvano mapiranje kolona"); invalid mapping ("Neispravno mapiranje kolona: …", or neither / both of `amount` and `debit`+`credit`); binary file ("Fajl nije CSV"); unparseable rows, up to 10 listed ("Red 5: neispravan datum …; Red 9: …"); no lines found

**Side effects:** the CSV is stored as a private StoredFile (`text/csv`); the mapping is saved on the bank account (`importMapping`, returned by Get Finance Overview) for the next upload; `AuditLog` row for the import.

Edits one line of a draft import during review. Omitted fields stay as they are; `null` clears a field.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `id` (UUID, required) — the import
- `lineId` (UUID, required) — the line

**Body fields (all optional):**
- `categoryId` (UUID | null) — must match the line's direction and be active. Switching to a category that is not an owner payment clears `unitId`.
- `unitId` (UUID | null) — a unit of this building; only allowed with an owner-payment category
- `invoiceId` (UUID | null) — an invoice of this HOA that is not cancelled; expense lines only. It does not change the category.
- `skip` (boolean)

**Response:** the updated line `{ id, importId, lineNo, externalId, direction, amount, valueDate, counterpartyName, counterpartyAccount, reference, purpose, categoryId, unitId, invoiceId, skip, isDuplicate, transactionId, category, unit, invoice }` — without `issues`; refetch Get Statement Import for the new summary and issues. Status `200`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — invalid fields
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — import / line / category / unit / invoice not found in this building
- `409` — the import is no longer a draft ("Izvod više nije u nacrtu"), or the line is a duplicate ("Stavka je već proknjižena")
- `422` — category of the other direction or inactive; `unitId` without an owner-payment category; invoice on an income line; cancelled invoice

Books every line that is neither skipped nor a duplicate as a transaction (`source: "IMPORT"`), all or nothing. Lines with an invoice pay it, up to its open amount.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `id` (UUID, required) — the import

**Body:** none.

**Response:** the committed import, same shape as Get Statement Import (`status: "COMMITTED"`, `committedAt` set, `transactionId` on each booked line). Lines booked by another statement since the draft was made are marked `isDuplicate` and not booked again. Status `201`.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — import not found in this building
- `409` — already committed or discarded ("Izvod je već proknjižen ili odbačen")
- `422` — the account is inactive, or lines cannot be booked; the message lists them all, e.g. "Red 4: nedostaje kategorija; Red 5: period je zaključen objavljenim izveštajem; Red 7: faktura F-12 je već plaćena". Nothing is booked.

**Side effects:** `AuditLog` row per transaction and for the import; each owner payment with a unit notifies that unit's account ("Uplata evidentirana", as Create Transaction).

Discards a draft import without booking anything. The uploaded CSV stays stored.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `id` (UUID, required) — the import

**Body:** none.

**Response:** the import, same shape as Get Statement Import, with `status: "DISCARDED"`. Status `201`.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — import not found in this building
- `409` — already committed or discarded

**Side effects:** `AuditLog` row.

Every yearly budget (program održavanja) of the building's HOA, newest year first.

**Who can call it:** Any active member of this building (UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, RESIDENT) or SUPER_ADMIN.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)

**Response:** array of budgets, same shape as Get Budget.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — not an active member of this building
- `404` — finances not set up

One year's budget. Plan vs. actual per category is in Get Finance Summary (`planned`).

**Who can call it:** Any active member of this building (UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, RESIDENT) or SUPER_ADMIN.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `year` (integer, required)

**Response:** `{ id, entityId, year, adoptedAt (date the assembly adopted it, or null), decisionDocumentId, createdAt, updatedAt, decisionDocument { id, title } | null, lines[] { id, budgetId, categoryId, plannedAmount (whole-year RSD), note, category { id, name, direction, fund } } }` — lines sorted by category name.

**Errors:**
- `400` — `year` is not an integer
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — not an active member of this building
- `404` — finances not set up, or no budget for that year

Creates or **replaces** a year's budget: lines not listed are removed and omitted `adoptedAt` / `decisionDocumentId` are cleared.

**Who can call it:** UPRAVNIK of this building or SUPER_ADMIN. BOARD_MEMBER and RESIDENT get `403`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `buildingId` (UUID, required)
- `year` (integer 2000–2100, required)

**Body fields:**
- `adoptedAt` (string `YYYY-MM-DD` | null, optional)
- `decisionDocumentId` (UUID | null, optional) — e.g. the assembly decision in Documents
- `lines[]` (required): `categoryId` (UUID, required, a category of this HOA, each at most once), `plannedAmount` (decimal string ≥ 0, required), `note` (string, optional)

**Response:** the saved budget, same shape as Get Budget. Status `200`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — invalid fields (negative or malformed amount, bad date, `year` not an integer)
- `401` — not authenticated
- `403` — caller is not the UPRAVNIK of this building (or SUPER_ADMIN)
- `404` — finances not set up, or the decision document is not in this building

## What this endpoint does

Creates a new discussion thread in the **complex-level forum** — a shared communication space visible to all members across every lamela (building) within the same complex. This is distinct from the per-building forum: a resident in Lamela 1 can read and respond to a thread started by a resident in Lamela 3.

The complex forum should only be displayed in the UI when the authenticated user's building has a `complexId` — if the building has no complex, this forum does not exist and these endpoints must not be called.

## Where to get complexId

`complexId` is returned on each building object in `GET /auth/me` under `buildingMembers[].building`. Check if it is non-null before showing the complex forum tab. Pass it as the path parameter.

## Who can call it

Any authenticated user who is a member (RESIDENT, BOARD_MEMBER, or UPRAVNIK) of at least one building that belongs to this complex. Returns `403` if the user has no membership in any building of this complex.

## Auth

Bearer token required — include `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}` header.

## Path params

- `complexId` (UUID, required) — the complex the thread belongs to

## Body fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `title` | string | yes | Short headline for the thread, shown in the list view |
| `body` | string | yes | Full opening post body |
| `category` | enum | yes | `GENERAL`, `MAINTENANCE`, `COMPLAINT`, or `QUESTION` |

## Success response — 201

Returns the created thread object. Fields:
- `id` — UUID of the new thread (save this for navigation)
- `complexId` — UUID of the complex
- `authorId` — UUID of the user who created it
- `title`, `body`, `category` — as submitted
- `status` — always `OPEN` on creation
- `createdAt`, `updatedAt` — ISO 8601 timestamps

## Error responses

- `400` — validation failed (missing or invalid field)
- `401` — no token or token expired
- `403` — authenticated user is not a member of any building in this complex

## What this endpoint does

Marks a complex thread as `CLOSED`. A closed thread remains fully readable — the title, body, and all replies are still returned by the GET endpoints — but it signals that the discussion is resolved. There is no reopen endpoint.

## Who can close a thread

Three categories of users may close a thread:

1. **UPRAVNIK** — can close any thread in the complex regardless of who authored it
2. **BOARD_MEMBER** — any board member of any building in the complex can close any thread (the caller's highest role across the complex counts)
3. **Thread author** — the user who created the thread can close their own thread regardless of role

All other users receive `403`. On the frontend, only show the Close button to users who meet one of these conditions. Check: `thread.authorId === currentUser.id || currentUser.role === 'UPRAVNIK' || currentUser.role === 'BOARD_MEMBER'`.

## Auth

Bearer token required.

## Path params

- `complexId` (UUID, required)
- `id` (UUID, required) — the thread to close

## Success response — 200

The full updated thread object with `status: 'CLOSED'`. Update the thread in local state with this response so the UI immediately reflects the closed status and hides the reply input.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | UUID | Thread ID |
| `complexId` | UUID | |
| `authorId` | UUID | |
| `title` | string | |
| `body` | string | |
| `category` | enum | |
| `status` | `"CLOSED"` | Will always be `CLOSED` in this response |
| `createdAt` | ISO 8601 | |
| `updatedAt` | ISO 8601 | Reflects the time of closing |

## Error responses

- `401` — no token or token expired
- `403` — user is not UPRAVNIK, BOARD_MEMBER, or the thread author
- `404` — thread not found

- `title` — short notification title
- `body` — notification body text
- `isRead` — boolean, whether the user has read it
- `link` — optional deep-link URL (nullable)
- `createdAt`

request.description:
Marks a single notification as read. Only the recipient of the notification may mark it as read.

**Who can call it:** Any authenticated user, and only for notifications addressed to them.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `id` (UUID, required) — the notification ID

**Response:** The updated notification object with `isRead: true`.

**Errors:**
- `401` — not authenticated
- `404` — notification not found, or it does not belong to the authenticated user
